en.headline: Fire at Wong Chuk Hang temple suspected caused by incense
en.dek: Firefighters extinguished a blaze at Tai Wong Ye Temple on Nam Long Shan Road in about 10 minutes; no one was injured.
body: A fire broke out at Tai Wong Ye Temple at 1 Nam Long Shan Road in Wong Chuk Hang on Tuesday night. Police received multiple reports of smoke and flames around 11.41pm.

Fire Services Department crews arrived with one hose line and a breathing apparatus team and extinguished the fire at about 11.51pm. Initial investigations suggested incense may have ignited a nearby metal rack.
No injuries were reported. Video footage circulating online showed flames and smoke rising from the temple roof. The Fire Services Department is investigating the cause.

zh.headline: 黃竹坑大王爺廟起火 懷疑香火誤燒鐵架
zh.dek: 消防約10分鐘撲熄南朗山道大王爺廟火警，無人受傷。
body: 黃竹坑南朗山道1號大王爺廟周二晚上發生火警。警方約晚上11時41分接獲多名市民報案指廟宇冒煙起火。
消防出動一條喉及一隊煙帽隊到場灌救，約晚上11時51分將火撲熄。初步調查懷疑香火火種誤燒附近鐵架肇禍。
事件中無人受傷。網上影片顯示廟宇屋頂火光及濃煙。消防處正調查起火原因。
